column1: # Scientific-name supersessions: a spelling that is no longer current, and the
# spelling this app writes instead. One direction only, superseded to current.
# Derived from the BirdNET v2.4 and v3.0 label sets, 175 pairs. When
# regenerating against a new model release, a pair is only valid if the
# superseded name is NOT a live class of every model that ships. Skipping that
# check is what produced the duplicate-row bug described in
# docs/one-species-namespace.md, because BirdNET v3.0 carries 27 of these
# superseded spellings as classes of its own alongside the current ones.
